definitions.adjacency: Within one original file; original DateTime difference 950..1050 ms; finite values of this specific field at both ends. All seams and missing values reset event interval chains.
definitions.change: Exact inequality between parsed float64 original CSV values; no tolerance, smoothing, interpolation or numerical downcast.
definitions.changed_pair_ratio: Changed finite 950..1050 ms adjacent pairs / all finite 950..1050 ms adjacent pairs; empirical fraction of approximately one-second links showing value change.
definitions.unchanged_pair_ratio: Equal finite 950..1050 ms adjacent pairs / all finite 950..1050 ms adjacent pairs. An unchanged value is not missing.
definitions.change_interval: DateTime separation between two consecutive change events in the same finite within-file contiguous chain. First events are left-censored and file/segment-end holds are right-censored.
definitions.quantiles: Exact linear-interpolated numpy-style quantiles of all eligible event intervals, reconstructed from integer millisecond histograms; not means of per-file quantiles.
definitions.near_1s_change_interval_ratio: Event intervals in [0.950,1.050] seconds / all eligible consecutive change-event intervals. This denominator differs from changed_pair_ratio.
definitions.max_observed_constant_run_duration_s: Longest observed same-value run from its first to last timestamp, including boundary-censored runs, never joining a gap or file seam.
definitions.interpretation: A CSV row each second does not prove a sensor internally refreshes at 1 Hz. No change may represent a held command, constant physical state, limited resolution or slower device refresh; this audit does not disambiguate those causes.
definitions.state_and_age: operation_point is a dimensionless state code; OpHrs2 is operating hours, not DateTime elapsed seconds. Slow changes, zero increments and quantization remain valid observations, not missing data.

clock_count_correction.method: Read-only original clock memmaps; np.diff over all actual N rows, no prepend; exactly N-1 actual adjacent pairs. Includes real file seams for raw_audit count parity, not for instrument event continuity.
clock_count_correction.diagnosis: The previous audit counted a synthesized first-row previous timestamp and age in clock_counts. Correct metadata only; raw values, cache, valid windows, frozen protocol and thresholds remain unchanged.
